registration_agreement_terms:
Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade Agreement

Dear parents, please read and sign the terms and conditions of this agreement to ensure clarity regarding the service and attendance policy for children at Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade.

Rules and terms:

HEALTH, SAFETY AND SICKNESS
1. Children who are unwell should not attend the play area. Children who have suffered from flu, coughing, fever or diarrhea will not be admitted back to the play area within 72 hours. Parents must inform the play area immediately if their child is suffering from any contagious disease to take safety and preventive measures.
2. For the safety of the other children in the play area, we cannot allow children to attend the play area if they are suffering from a contagious disease, which could easily be passed on to another child during normal daily activities of the play area.
3. Children are not allowed to bring small or unsafe toys which could hurt or harm the child or other children.

SECURITY
1. Policy regarding Drop-offs and Pick-ups — only the parent/guardian and authorized adults who sign the children into Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade may pick up the kids.
2. Parent/guardian or other authorized adult must present their ID at the time of pick up.
3. If the child becomes sick or shows symptoms of sickness such as fever, coughing or flu during their stay at Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade, staff will contact the parent(s) and ask them to pick up their child as soon as possible and not more than one hour, to ensure the child's safety. Any deterioration in a child's health caused by a parent's delay in picking up the child is not the management's responsibility.
4. Should a child have an infectious disease, such as an ear or throat infection, coughing, flu or diarrhea, they should not return to Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade until they have been clear for at least 72 hours. The center's management reserves the right to refuse admission of a child showing these symptoms, to ensure the safety of all children visiting the center.
5. Allergies/Medical Information — please describe any allergies (food, animals, medication, etc.) and any physical, emotional, developmental or other conditions relevant to the care of your child in the Allergies section of this form.
6. Media Release — from time to time, we take pictures/videos of various events, groups, etc. and post them on our Facebook, Instagram, Google and other social media platforms. Your media release choice below records your permission.
7. If your child shows inappropriate or violent behaviour toward other kids, management reserves the right to refuse your child's attendance at Kiddie Jungle kids amusement arcade for the safety of all children, and to cancel this agreement without advance notice.

Note: In order to protect children with allergies, we ask you not to bring any snacks or drinks that might be shared with other children.

FEES
1. All fees are payable in advance, in full, before your child starts attending the centre.
2. Fees are payable in full within 2 days of the beginning of each month; otherwise, the centre's management reserves the right to refuse admission of the child until payment is made.
3. Kiddie Jungle management is not responsible for any payments, special tips or gratuities for staff, which do not belong to the company's rules.
4. If the child attends three days or more of a monthly attendance agreement, parents do not have the right to request a refund of monthly fees.

By signing below, I/we confirm we have read, understood and agree to the terms and conditions above, which form part of this agreement along with the registration form completed for this child.
